assertions.assertion: Check that Agent clearly identifies that policy only does not allow change of cabin for only some of the passengers. All passengers must fly in the same cabin.

assertions.assertion: Check that agent correctly adds 2 checked bags for free.
assertions.rationale: The agent confirms in [15] that adding 2 bags is within the free allowance with 'Additional cost: $0', then calls update_reservation_baggages with total_baggages: 2 and nonfree_baggages: 0 in [17], and confirms in [19] that 'Total checked bags: 2 (all within your Gold member free allowance)' with 'Additional charge: $0'.

summary: Both assertions satisfied: agent clearly stated the same-cabin policy and correctly added 2 free checked bags.
